en: A vintage monochrome postcard view of a historic market square. On the left stands a large Gothic church with a tall clock tower and arched windows, opening onto the square. In front and to the right are several multi‑story townhouses with shops at street level, their facades bearing business names. Behind them rise wooded slopes and additional buildings. The title "Meissen. Markt." appears at the top, and the left margin lists the publisher.
